input.question: Why did the refund agent pay refunds it should not have?

evidence.title: Refund policy versions
evidence.sql: SELECT version, max_return_days, valid_from, valid_to, note FROM SHOP_PG.policy_versions ORDER BY version
rows: Refunds within 14 days of delivery (finance change FIN-212)
evidence.report: Policy v1 allows 30 days from 2026-01-01 to 2026-10-18 (Refunds within 30 days of delivery); Policy v2 allows 14 days from 2026-10-18 and is live (Refunds within 14 days of delivery (finance change FIN-212)).

evidence.title: What the refund agent ran with
evidence.sql: SELECT policy_in_prompt, routed_model, reasoning, count(*) AS decisions FROM BB_FILES.agent_traces GROUP BY policy_in_prompt, routed_model, reasoning
rows: Refunds are allowed within 30 days of delivery.
evidence.report: 132 refund decisions ran on nvidia/nemotron-3.5-lightning-30b-a3b (reasoning requested off), prompted with the policy "Refunds are allowed within 30 days of delivery.".

evidence.title: Ops tickets after the incident
evidence.sql: SELECT ticket_id, team, subject FROM BB_FILES.ops_tickets ORDER BY opened_at
rows: Return window change FIN-212 live since 18 Oct
evidence.report: Ops tickets after the incident: OPS-881 (Finance) "Refund payouts spiked today"; OPS-882 (Support) "Payments provider returning duplicate IDs?"; OPS-883 (Finance) "Return window change FIN-212 live since 18 Oct".

evidence.title: Refunds paid past the live window
evidence.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS refunds, sum(f.amount_egp) AS egp, min(datediff(timestamp '2026-10-21 10:00:00', o.delivered_at)) AS min_days, max(datediff(timestamp '2026-10-21 10:00:00', o.delivered_at)) AS max_days
FROM SHOP_PG.refunds f JOIN SHOP_PG.orders o ON o.id = f.order_id
WHERE datediff(timestamp '2026-10-21 10:00:00', o.delivered_at) > (SELECT max_return_days FROM SHOP_PG.policy_versions WHERE valid_to IS NULL)
evidence.report: 40 refunds totalling 69,422 EGP were paid for orders delivered 15 to 29 days before the incident, past the live return window.

evidence.title: Why the agent paid past the window
evidence.sql:
SELECT t.reason, count(*) AS payouts FROM BB_FILES.agent_traces t JOIN SHOP_PG.refunds f ON f.request_id = t.request_id
WHERE t.days_since_delivery > (SELECT max_return_days FROM SHOP_PG.policy_versions WHERE valid_to IS NULL) GROUP BY t.reason ORDER BY payouts DESC
rows: Delivered 21 days ago, within 30-day refund window
Eligible within 30-day window, not as described
Within 30-day return window for wrong size
evidence.report: Paid refunds past the live window, by the agent's own stated reason: "Within 30-day refund window" ×30, "Within 30-day return window" ×3, "Delivered 21 days ago, within 30-day refund window" ×1, and 6 more reasons.

evidence.title: Duplicate payment refs, ticket vs payments
evidence.sql:
SELECT t.ticket_id, count(p.id) AS payments, count(DISTINCT p.provider_ref) AS distinct_refs
FROM BB_FILES.ops_tickets t CROSS JOIN SHOP_PG.payments p
WHERE lower(t.subject) LIKE '%duplicate%' GROUP BY t.ticket_id
evidence.report: OPS-882 asks about duplicate payment IDs; the payments table has 132 payments with 132 distinct provider refs, so 0 duplicates.

evidence.title: Requests refunded more than once
evidence.sql: SELECT count(*) AS refunds, count(DISTINCT request_id) AS refunded_requests FROM SHOP_PG.refunds
evidence.report: 120 refunds were issued for 120 distinct requests, so 0 requests were refunded more than once.

verdict.why: 132 payments have 132 distinct provider refs with 0 duplicates, directly contradicting the claim.
The agent repeatedly invoked the 30-day refund window for deliveries after 2026-10-18, confirming operation under expired Policy v1 despite Policy v2 being live.
Evidence [A2] directly confirms 40 refunds totalling 69,422 EGP for orders delivered 15–29 days before the incident, past the 14-day return window, supporting the claim.
Evidence [B2] lists the exact phrase counts and explicitly states they were for refunds past the live window, directly supporting the claim.

note: compiling the root cause into a guardrail (no model call)

contract.clause: issue_refund pays only when the days since delivery are within max_return_days of the live refund policy.
contract.context: Live policy at proposal: v2, 14 days. Root cause L2: The refund agent operated under Policy v1's 30-day refund window despite Policy v2's live 14-day window taking effect on 2026-10-18.
